Create an OpenFOAM case for 2D axisymmetric transient spray combustion of liquid n-dodecane (nC12H26) in hot co-flow air inside a cylindrical chamber using the k-epsilon turbulence model.
Geometry: cylindrical combustion chamber, length 0.2 m, diameter 0.1 m (radius 0.05 m), modeled as 2D axisymmetric (one azimuthal cell as a wedge).
Mesh: blockMesh-generated, 100 cells axially, 50 cells radially, with grid refinement near the center axis (r=0) and near the injector end (inlet plane).
Turbulence model: standard k-epsilon (RASModel kEpsilon).
Inlet boundary condition (co-flow air, at the inlet plane): fixedValue velocity U=(10,0,0) m/s, fixedValue temperature T=800 K, fixedValue pressure p=101325 Pa, fixedValue mass fractions O2=0.233 and N2=0.767.
Outlet boundary condition: totalPressure for pressure, zeroGradient for velocity, temperature, and turbulent quantities.
Wall boundary condition: noSlip for velocity, fixedValue temperature T=400 K, zeroGradient for turbulent quantities.
Initial condition for the entire domain: temperature 800 K, pressure 101325 Pa, velocity zero, mass fractions O2=0.233 and N2=0.767, turbulence quantities initialized to physically reasonable small values consistent with 800 K air.
Injector location: on the center axis (r=0) at the inlet plane (leftmost boundary face).
Spray model: cone.
Fuel: n-dodecane (nC12H26), liquid phase.
Spray mass flow rate: 0.002 kg/s.
Droplet injection temperature: 300 K.
Droplet size distribution: Rosin-Rammler, mean diameter 50e-6 m, shape parameter left at software default.
Droplet heat and mass transfer model: RanzMarshall.
Droplet drag model: standard.
Chemistry: two-step global reaction mechanism. Step 1 (incomplete oxidation): nC12H26 + 6 O2 -> 12 CO + 13 H2O. Step 2 (complete oxidation): CO + 0.5 O2 -> CO2.
Species set: nC12H26, O2, N2, CO, CO2, H2O.
Thermodynamic property format: janaf (constant/thermophysicalProperties uses janaf thermodynamics; no polynomial format).
Configure constant/combustionProperties and constant/reactionSchemes consistent with the two-step mechanism and the six-species set.
Time control: transient solver, endTime = 0.05 s, adjustableTimeStep with maxCo = 0.7, writeInterval = 0.001 s (producing exactly 50 output frames).
Write all parameters exactly as specified with no substitutions or rounding.
